assessment: This important study reveals a novel mechanism that links iron stress to anti-oxidant protection for the gut commensal and opportunistic pathogen Candida albicans in colonization of the gastrointestinal tract. Through a series of convincing experiments, the authors show that phosphorylation and degradation of Hap43, a well-established regulator of Candida albicans iron homeostasis, underlies the interaction between this gut commensal and the mammalian gut. The work will be of interest to microbiologists working on microbiota and microbial commensalism.
